opportunities.title: Regular Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, Charitable Incorporated Organisations (CIOs), and organisations exempt or excepted under Charity Commission guidance. Applicants must have at least one year's worth of annual accounts. Individuals, CICs, community benefit societies, social enterprises, and local authorities are not funded.
opportunities.summary: Regular Grant programme for grants under £100,000, supporting operating/core costs, capital projects, or specific projects/activities. Open to applications all year round with no deadlines.

opportunities.title: Major Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Organisations must either have an annual income of £1 million or over (for core costs), or total project/capital costs of at least £1 million (for capital or project costs). Applicants must be UK registered charities or CIOs eligible for Foundation funding.
opportunities.summary: Major Grant programme for grants of £100,000 and over, considered by Trustees at one of eight Board meetings per year. Supports capital/project costs or core costs. Expressions of Interest accepted all year round with no submission deadlines, reviewed on a rolling basis.
